name: Threat Intel Quick Analysis - Email - New
description: See the frequency of Email threats by Actor, Log Source, Malicious Confidence, and view trends over time.
title: Threat Intel Quick Analysis - Email - New

queries.queryString:
_collector = "Labs - GoogleApps" OR _sourceCategory = Labs/AWS*  (user or email or login or userid or user_id)
| parse regex "(?<email_address>[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,4})" 
| timeslice 5m
|where if ("{{_source}}" = "*", true, _source matches "{{_source}}")
|count as email_count by email_address, _timeslice
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=email_address
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name 
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| where type="email_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as Actor
|sum (email_count) as threat_count by _timeslice
